notes.title: 1.2 Patch - lots of bugfixes
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Here are the patch notes for version [b]1.2[/b], out now on PC/Mac and Switch (Full game & Demo)[/p][p]We've been fixing a bunch of smaller bugs after the release! As work on the new content is starting, expect frequency of patches to slow down :) [/p][p][/p][p]As always, don't hesitate to get in touch via mail/forum/discord if you have any issue with the game! Thanks everyone for your support.[/p][p][/p][p]Here are some of the notable changes, you can find the [url="https://squeakross.cool/news/articles/squeakross-home-squeak-home-1-dot-2-patch-notes"][b]Full patch notes here[/b][/url][/p][p][/p][h3]Fixes: [/h3][list][*][p]\[Puzzles] Fixed the "Force separator spacing to 5" working incorrectly on 16 sized puzzles [/p][/*][*][p]\[Stickers] Stickers are now saved and loaded in the correct order. Your previous layout will possibly need adjustments [/p][/*][*][p]\[Costumes] Fix color variations for the following costumes: Pirate Mustache/Hat/Scarf, Angel Wings/Disc[/p][/*][*][p]\[House] Fix color variations for the following items: Washer Dryer combo, Fancy Fridge [/p][/*][/list][h3]Changes: [/h3][list][*][p]\[List View] Overall navigation & sorting improved [/p][/*][*][p]\[UI] "Main Menu" title disappear after a few seconds, more space for stickers! [/p][/*][*][p]\[House] Decor Browser: Side Bar navigation improved [/p][/*][*][p]\[Puzzle] Cone of Shame magically scales down when starting a Squeakross to prevent overlap with the grid [/p][/*][/list][h3]New: [/h3][list][*][p]\[List View] List view now displays best times[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you! [/p][p][/p][p][url="https://squeakross.cool/news/articles/squeakross-home-squeak-home-1-dot-2-patch-notes" style="button"]FULL PATCH NOTES[/url][/p][p][/p][p]-Alex[/p][h3][/h3]

tags.bug: [Puzzles] Fixed the "Force separator spacing to 5" working incorrectly on 16 sized puzzles
[Stickers] Stickers are now saved and loaded in the correct order. Your previous layout will possibly need adjustments
[Costumes] Fix color variations for the following costumes: Pirate Mustache/Hat/Scarf, Angel Wings/Disc
[House] Fix color variations for the following items: Washer Dryer combo, Fancy Fridge

tags.feature: [UI] "Main Menu" title disappear after a few seconds, more space for stickers!

tags.balance_change: [House] Decor Browser: Side Bar navigation improved
[Puzzle] Cone of Shame magically scales down when starting a Squeakross to prevent overlap with the grid

notes.title: 1.1b Patch
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Here are the patch notes for version [b]1.1b[/b]. The changes are fixes to achievements and the auto-cross system.[/p][p][/p][table equalcells="1" colwidth=""][tr][th][p][b]Fixes:[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Auto-cross system redone, more robust[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Fix undo redo sometimes broken when using auto-cross completed lines[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Achievement fix: "Book#1 normal complete!" now granted at the proper time[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Achievement fix: fix furniture set achievements (Open the game to get them retroactively)[/p][/td][/tr][tr][th][p][b]Changes:[/b][/p][/th][/tr][tr][td][p]Removed discord button in main menu[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Auto added ❌crosses have different visuals.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]"Fresh Veggie" removed from the Copyright free list as it's now part of the Content-ID system[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Improved mouse controls at high speed![/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]Tweak puzzles that required guessing to solve: 171-N 116-N[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]The game now creates a backup save at regular interval. It will try to load that save if you main save file is corrupted.[/p][/td][/tr][tr][td][p]When a line has a single ❌/🧀/🔵, you'll be allowed to continue drawing on that line[/p][/td][/tr][/table][p]Note: If you add 171-N or 116-N Suspended, you will have to start them from scratch as the puzzle were modified.[/p][p]Switch patch still in testing, please check [url="https://squeakross.cool/bugs"]https://squeakross.cool/bugs[/url] for more info[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you! [/p][p][/p][p]Steam Discussion thread =>  [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2871440/discussions/0/594026830163377616/" style="button"]DISCUSS[/url][/p][p][/p][p]-Alex[/p][h3][/h3]

tags.bug: Auto-cross system redone, more robust
Fix undo redo sometimes broken when using auto-cross completed lines
Achievement fix: "Book#1 normal complete!" now granted at the proper time
Achievement fix: fix furniture set achievements (Open the game to get them retroactively)

notes.title: [DEMO] Version 1.0
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 

New demo update! We've been hard at work on the game, and it's time to make sure the demo reflects the full game! If you look at the release number, you'll probably guess that release is not that far 😏

[h1]Patch notes:[/h1]

[h3]Changes/New Features - PUZZLE :[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]Adjusted Puzzle UI for better readability[/b]
[*] You can display a "Reference sheet" in game
[*] Manual Scribbling of hints updated, can be done with a controller
[*] Reduce Hint zoom to avoid going offscreen. Enable zoom by default for large puzzles
[*] Tons of new music (with funny titles) + ability to skip the current track in the pause menu.
[*] When winning a costume's challenge puzzle, you will try on the displayed color variation
[*] Suspend limit added: You can only suspend up to 5 puzzles at a time per catalog
[/list]

[h3]Changes/New Features - RODENT EDITOR:[/h3]
[list]
[*] New patterns, and updated existing patterns
[*] Dual eyes colors option
[*] Paw fur
[*] Missing eyes
[*] New whisker color option
[/list]

[h3]Changes/New Features - HOUSE:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b]House Camera controls completely redone for controller![/b]
[*] "NEW" notification for unlocked decor/costumes
[*] You can toggle the time on/off in Photo mode
[*] Red placement indicator for blocked placement
[*] Improve Wallpaper/Ground selection
[*] Many rodent reactions added (Limited in the demo!)
[*] Added brain cells the rodent AI, it should be (a tiny bit) more intelligent
[/list]

[h3]Changes/New Features - OTHERS:[/h3]
[list]
[*][b] Save location was changed! There is now one save per user on the same 
computer[/b]
[*] List view UI rework. Suspended puzzles appear on top 
[*] Catalog navigation dots will show an [⏸] icon on pages with suspended puzzles
[*] [b]LANGUAGES ADDED: French, Simplified Chinese, Japanese, Spanish[/b]
[/list]

[h3]Bugfixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fix hints issue when resuming a suspended puzzle 
[*] Catalog pages can be scrolled by holding a key
[*] The catalog opens at the right page when giving up or suspending a puzzle
[*] Fix Logic-Assist messing up the Undo/redo buffer
[*] Fix an issue where controls were stuck for a few seconds at the beginning of tutorial#2
[*] Typos, Text fixes,...
[/list]

There are few more stuff not shown here, as it would be spoiler for the full game 🤓

-Alex

notes.title: Steam next fest DEMO!
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We're part of the Steam next fest! Feel free to try out our demo if you haven't it has a few hours of content (30 normal puzzles + 30 challenges)!

Demo feature list: 

[list]
[*] 60 puzzles (including 30 "Nini's Challenges")
[*] Beginner friendly tutorial, and illustrated in-game manual
[*] Fully customizable hint system
[*] Call your rodent to help you during gameplay. Use the unique "Logic-Assist" to help you solve difficult lines
[*] Manually scribble hints for a paper-like experience
[*] 60 furniture and 16 costumes in demo
[*] Many puzzle accessibility features (Rebindable controls, zoom, auto count...)
[*] Night Mode
[*] Click to squeak!
[*] Photo mode
[/list]

Enjoy!

notes.title: [DEMO] Version 0.43
notes.content:
Hello everyone, 
This update addresses some of the most common feedback we got.
We'll try to update the demo regularly, to make sure the demo reflects the full game as best as it can.

Patch notes:

Changes/New Features:
[list]
[*] Improved separator lines visibility
[*] New game Setting: High contrast separators
[*] New game Setting: Force separators spacing to 5 
[*] New game Setting: Change Completed hints behavior
[*] Rodent Editor UI tweaks 
[*] Audio/Video settings can be accessed from the rodent editor
[*] [b]When setting "Completed hints" to "Manual", you can now scribble hints. Give it a try its really cool![/b]. Note: Only works with Mouse currently!
[*] Reduced volume of some annoying sounds(Sliders & Dialogue). We'll update them in the future
[*] Added a step in the chair placement tutorial
[*] Temporarily changed the "Count" feature icon
[*] Moved "Keep it on?" button to the center during game win screen
[*] Changed "Get Help" to "Call {Rodent Name}
[*] Locked items are now hidden by default in browser
[*] Added temporary controls help panel in game (M)
[*] Temporary marks bind changed from ALT to F

[/list]

Bugfixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the cheesemail not marking as read. [b]NOTE: If you had played before, all cheesemail will be marked as read again you'll have to read them all again![/b]
[/list]


-Alex
